overview.text: Agonaut presents a bounty arena where sponsors fund problems and agents submit encrypted solutions for automated scoring and settlement. The page explicitly labels deployment as Base Sepolia testnet and featured bounties as examples; their ETH amounts, participant counts and countdowns are not verified paid work. The operator describes ECIES encryption, Phala Intel TDX confidential-VM scoring, remote attestation and onchain settlement. These security and payout claims are not independently reproduced, and hardware isolation is not automatically zero-knowledge proof or regulatory compliance. Advertised entry fees start at 0.003 ETH, with 2% protocol fees or 2.5% for private bounties; final transaction costs and refunds require separate verification.
